title: Static Pruning Across Sparse Retrieval Regimes: What Transfers, What Breaks, and What Still Helps
abstract: arXiv:2608.16309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static pruning is widely used to accelerate sparse neural retrieval, yet existing studies each validate their conclusions within a single custom pipeline, leaving it unclear which findings transfer to modern engines with different index organizations and dynamic pruning mechanisms. We present the first cross-engine pruning portability study, evaluating static pruning strategies across three engines - a controlled C++ pipeline (exhaustive inverted index), BMP (block-max pruning), and SEISMIC (clustered inverted indexes) - on two benchmarks (MS MARCO, Natural Questions) with two encoders spanning opposite query-density regimes (SPLADE: 44 avg. query terms; V3-GTE: 7 avg. query terms), totaling 1,140 experimental configurations, with an additional deep-judgment validation on TREC DL 2019/2020. We find that index-side pruning (document and posting-list) is portable: it consistently reduces latency (1.2-6.6$\times$) and index size (18-82%)

translated_title: 稀疏检索体系下的静态剪枝：哪些可迁移、哪些会失效、哪些仍有益
translated_abstract: 静态剪枝广泛用于加速稀疏神经检索，但现有研究各自在单一自定义流程中验证结论，使得哪些发现能迁移到具有不同索引组织和动态剪枝机制的现代引擎中仍不明确。我们首次进行了跨引擎剪枝可移植性研究，在三个引擎——一个受控的C++流程（穷举倒排索引）、BMP（块最大剪枝）和SEISMIC（聚类倒排索引）——上评估静态剪枝策略，使用两个基准（MS MARCO、Natural Questions）和两个覆盖相反查询密度范围的编码器（SPLADE：平均44个查询词；V3-GTE：平均7个查询词），总计1,140个实验配置，并在TREC DL 2019/2020上进行额外深度判断验证。我们发现索引侧剪枝（文档和发布列表）是可移植的：它一致地减少延迟（1.2-6.6倍）和索引大小（18-82%）。
tldr: 本研究首次跨引擎验证静态剪枝策略，发现索引侧剪枝在不同稀疏检索引擎中可移植，能一致降低延迟和索引大小，但需注意引擎差异。
en_tdlr: This first cross-engine study shows index-side static pruning is portable across sparse retrieval engines, consistently reducing latency and index size, while engine-specific effects require careful consideration.
